# Neorgon Apps

> The catalog of the iPhone apps Neorgon makes, at https://apps.neorgon.com/,
> in Spanish. Each app has its icon, screenshots and links to its help and
> privacy policy. Apps without a site of their own keep those pages here.

## Apps

- Naninani: a Japanese reader. On the App Store. Help and privacy: https://yomu.neorgon.com/naninani/ and https://yomu.neorgon.com/naninani/privacy/
- Amigos de Enerbot: the Energon community's member app (pass, juntas, perks, Energones). Coming soon. Help and privacy, in Spanish: https://apps.neorgon.com/amigos/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/amigos/privacy/
- Pittari: finds the codes in ticket PDFs and screenshots, redraws them sharp, shows them full screen or adds them to Apple Wallet. On the App Store. Support and privacy, in English: https://apps.neorgon.com/pittari/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/pittari/privacy/
- Kurukuru (Hobby Orbit): a hobby wheel, learning in steps and your own rhythms, on iPhone and Apple Watch. Coming soon. Support and privacy, in English, on its own site: https://hobbyorbit.neorgon.com/kurukuru/ and https://hobbyorbit.neorgon.com/kurukuru/privacy/
- HeadPain: a headache diary with a 3D head map and a report for a doctor. Coming soon. Support and privacy, in English: https://apps.neorgon.com/headpain/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/headpain/privacy/
- Enerbot Doll (it was Chokon): Enerbot as a robot doll you pose and keep on your widgets; a poke makes him react, and touches and days unlock wigs and accessories. On the App Store. Help and privacy, in Spanish: https://apps.neorgon.com/enerbot-doll/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/enerbot-doll/privacy/
- Celular Listo: an Android checklist for getting a relative's phone ready (backups, accounts, ease of use, locks, emergency). It shows how each setting stands and where to change it, and changes nothing itself. Coming soon to Google Play. Help and privacy, in Spanish: https://apps.neorgon.com/celular-listo/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/celular-listo/privacy/; in English: https://apps.neorgon.com/celular-listo/en/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/celular-listo/en/privacy/

## Notes

- The help and privacy pages load no script.
- None of the apps has terms of its own; on the App Store, Apple's standard licence applies.
- Contact: support@neorgon.org (Amigos de Enerbot and Celular Listo: contact@neorgon.com).
